topic.label: Travel and Outdoors
topic.desc: Getting somewhere and being outside: trip and route planning, hiking, trails and parks, weather and conditions, bookings and permits.

concepts: Planning trips: destinations, itineraries, transport and routes between places.
Hikes and trails: finding a hike, distance, elevation gain, difficulty, trailheads and parks.
Weather forecasts, seasons, daylight and conditions that affect travel and outdoor plans.
Reservations, campsites, park permits, passes and entry requirements.
skills: Plans a day-by-day itinerary with travel times between stops.
Finds hikes near a place by distance, elevation gain and difficulty, with trailhead coordinates.
Briefs the safety needs of a hike: water, daylight, weather, terrain and turnaround time.
Checks forecast, daylight and seasonal conditions for a place and date.
Finds whether a park, trail or campsite needs a permit or reservation and how to get it.
mcp: Google Maps Platform MCP server: geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses and coordinates, place search and place details, distance matrix, elevation and directions.
OpenStreetMap MCP server: geocode addresses and place names to coordinates, find nearby places, route between locations, explore neighborhoods from open map data.
